purpose: Create, compose, step and replay bounded deterministic 2D physics scenes inside Universal Creation by preserving the existing platform physics core and adding creation-level materials, force fields, spring forces, drivers and scheduled actions around it.

properties.capability: create-fabric, add-body, add-bodies, step-fabric, simulate-fabric, inspect-fabric, query-point, or raycast
properties.fields: optional uniform, radial, vortex, or drag field definitions
properties.drivers: optional velocity or seek driver definitions

anatomy_refs.basis: Introduces an executable UC physics capsule while preserving the exact imported platform solver as the collision/integration authority.

limitations: candidate is not yet registered as a central UC live builtin
physics remains 2D and translation-only at the donor-core level
spring-distance constraints are force-based springs, not hard rigid joints
no continuous rigid-body rotation, angular inertia, deformables, fluids or 3D solver yet
cross-JavaScript-engine deterministic equivalence is not claimed
persistent_state: explicit fabric JSON supplied and retained by the caller

proves: donor core and adapter blob integrity
uniform radial vortex and drag fields

truth.basis: The original platform solver is copied byte-for-byte with recorded Git blob hashes, and unsupported rotation, rigid joints, 3D and scientific-validation claims remain explicit limitations.

agency.basis: Materials, bodies, fields, springs, drivers, actions and stepping are explicit caller-controlled data rather than hidden policy.

continuity.basis: The donor source remains untouched in a dedicated source directory while UC growth is additive and source lineage is retained in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The first growth wave composes bounded useful 2D capabilities around the proven core instead of pretending missing 3D, rotation or rigid-joint work is already solved.
